name: Artificial intelligence
description: Regulation of advanced AI systems and the infrastructure that runs them.

questions.oppose_means: Opposes making such disclosures and incident reports a legal requirement.
questions.support_means: Favors legally required safety disclosures and incident reporting for developers of the most powerful AI models.
questions.text: Should developers of the most powerful AI models be legally required to disclose their safety practices and report serious safety incidents to the government?
questions.notes: Bills to check when researching: California SB 1047 (2023-24 session) and SB 53 (2025-26 session).
